name: Data Cleanup Comment
script:
PAGE_LENGTH = 300
MAX_PACK = 10

log("Data Cleanup Comment: start")
doctype_infos = {d.name: d.issingle for d in frappe.get_all("DocType", fields=["name","issingle"])}
rules = frappe.get_doc("Data Cleanup Rules")
today = frappe.utils.getdate()
log("Data Cleanup Comment: today=%s" % (today,))
deleted_total = 0

for row in (rules.comment_rules or []):
    if not row.get("enabled") or not row.get("days"):
        log("Data Cleanup Comment rule skipped (disabled or no days)")
        continue
    cutoff = frappe.utils.add_days(today, -int(row.days))
    log("Data Cleanup Comment rule days=%s reference_doctype=%s cutoff=%s" % (row.days, row.get("reference_doctype") or "all", cutoff))
    doctypes_to_consider = [row.reference_doctype] if row.get("reference_doctype") else frappe.get_all(
        "Comment", filters=[["reference_doctype", "!=", ""]], pluck="reference_doctype", distinct=1)
    count = 0
    rule_deleted = 0
    
    for ref_dt in (doctypes_to_consider or []):
        if not ref_dt or ref_dt not in doctype_infos or doctype_infos.get(ref_dt):
            continue
        table_name = "`tab" + ref_dt.replace("`", "").replace(";", "") + "`"
        last_modified = None
        last_name = None
        ref_start = 0
        while True:
            if last_modified is None:
                sql = (
                    "SELECT name, modified FROM " + table_name +
                    " WHERE modified < %s ORDER BY modified ASC, name ASC LIMIT %s"
                )
                rows = frappe.db.sql(sql, (cutoff, PAGE_LENGTH), as_dict=1)
            else:
                sql = (
                    "SELECT name, modified FROM " + table_name +
                    " WHERE modified < %s AND (modified > %s OR (modified = %s AND name > %s))"
                    " ORDER BY modified ASC, name ASC LIMIT %s"
                )
                rows = frappe.db.sql(sql, (cutoff, last_modified, last_modified, last_name, PAGE_LENGTH), as_dict=1)

            if not rows:
                break
            
            ref_names = [r.name for r in rows]
            
            comment_offset = 0
            while True:
                comment_batch = frappe.get_all("Comment",
                    filters=[["reference_doctype","=",ref_dt], ["reference_name","in", ref_names],
                             ["modified","<", cutoff]] + ([["comment_type","=", row.comment_type]] if row.get("comment_type") else []),
                    fields=["name"], limit_start=comment_offset, limit_page_length=PAGE_LENGTH, order_by="name asc")
                if not comment_batch:
                    break
                pack_count = 0
                for c in comment_batch:
                    try:
                        frappe.delete_doc("Comment", c.name, force=1, ignore_permissions=True)
                        rule_deleted = rule_deleted + 1
                        pack_count = pack_count + 1
                        if pack_count >= MAX_PACK:
                            frappe.db.commit()
                            log("Data Cleanup Comment: committed batch of %s" % (MAX_PACK,))
                            pack_count = 0
                    except Exception as e:
                        frappe.log_error("Data Cleanup Comment delete error for %s" % (c.name,), e)
                if pack_count:
                    frappe.db.commit()
                    pack_count = 0
                comment_offset = comment_offset + PAGE_LENGTH

            # подготовка к следующей итерации keyset
            last_modified = rows[-1]["modified"]
            last_name = rows[-1]["name"]

    deleted_total = deleted_total + rule_deleted
    log("Data Cleanup Comment rule days=%s reference_doctype=%s deleted=%s" % (row.days, row.get("reference_doctype") or "all", rule_deleted))
    
    # Orphans: no link or broken link (use record modified date)
    log("Data Cleanup Comment: processing orphans (no link or broken link) cutoff=%s" % (cutoff,))
    count_no_link = 0
    orphan_start = 0
    while True:
        no_link_filters = [["modified", "<", cutoff]]
        if row.get("comment_type"):
            no_link_filters.append(["comment_type", "=", row.comment_type])
        no_link_or = [["reference_doctype", "=", ""], ["reference_name", "=", ""]]
        comment_names = frappe.get_all("Comment", filters=no_link_filters, or_filters=no_link_or, fields=["name"], order_by="modified", limit_start=orphan_start, limit_page_length=PAGE_LENGTH, pluck="name")
        if not comment_names:
            break
        pack_count = 0
        error_count = 0
        for name in comment_names:
            try:
                frappe.delete_doc("Comment", name, force=1, ignore_permissions=True)
                pack_count = pack_count + 1
                count_no_link = count_no_link + 1
                if pack_count >= MAX_PACK:
                    frappe.db.commit()
                    log("Data Cleanup Comment: committed batch of %s" % (MAX_PACK,))
                    pack_count = 0
            except Exception as e:
                error_count = error_count + 1
                frappe.log_error("Data Cleanup Comment delete error (orphan no-link) %s" % (name,), e)
                log("Data Cleanup: error deleting Comment %s (see Error Log)" % (name,))
            if pack_count:
                frappe.db.commit()
                pack_count = 0
        orphan_start = orphan_start + PAGE_LENGTH - len ( comment_names ) + error_count
    log("Data Cleanup Comment: orphan no-link deleted=%s" % (count_no_link,))
    deleted_total = deleted_total + count_no_link
    
    count_broken = 0
    orphan_start = 0
    while True:
        broken_filters = [["modified", "<", cutoff], ["reference_doctype", "!=", ""], ["reference_name", "!=", ""]]
        if row.get("comment_type"):
            broken_filters.append(["comment_type", "=", row.comment_type])
        rows_page = frappe.get_all("Comment", filters=broken_filters, fields=["name", "reference_doctype", "reference_name"], order_by="modified", limit_start=orphan_start, limit_page_length=PAGE_LENGTH)
        if not rows_page:
            break
        to_delete = []
        for r in rows_page:
            if not frappe.db.exists(r.reference_doctype, r.reference_name):
                to_delete.append(r.name)
        pack_count = 0
        error_count = 0
        for name in to_delete:
            try:
                frappe.delete_doc("Comment", name, force=1, ignore_permissions=True)
                pack_count = pack_count + 1
                count_broken = count_broken + 1
                if pack_count >= MAX_PACK:
                    frappe.db.commit()
                    log("Data Cleanup Comment: committed batch of %s" % (MAX_PACK,))
                    pack_count = 0
            except Exception as e:
                error_count = error_count + 1
                frappe.log_error("Data Cleanup Comment delete error (orphan broken-link) %s" % (name,), e)
                log("Data Cleanup: error deleting Comment %s (see Error Log)" % (name,))
            if pack_count:
                frappe.db.commit()
                pack_count = 0
        orphan_start = orphan_start + PAGE_LENGTH - len( to_delete ) + error_count
    log("Data Cleanup Comment: orphan broken-link deleted=%s" % (count_broken,))
    deleted_total = deleted_total + count_broken
    
log("Data Cleanup Comment: finished total_deleted=%s" % (deleted_total,))

script:
PAGE_LENGTH = 500
MAX_PACK = 10

log("Data Cleanup Event: start")
rules = frappe.get_doc("Data Cleanup Rules")
today = frappe.utils.getdate()
log("Data Cleanup Event: today=%s" % (today,))
deleted_total = 0
for row in (rules.event_rules or []):
    if not row.get("enabled") or not row.get("days"):
        log("Data Cleanup Event rule skipped (disabled or no days)")
        continue
    cutoff = frappe.utils.add_days(today, -int(row.days))
    log("Data Cleanup Event rule days=%s cutoff=%s" % (row.days, cutoff))
    query_base = """
        SELECT name FROM tabEvent
        WHERE GREATEST(
            COALESCE(starts_on, '1000-01-01 00:00:00'),
            COALESCE(ends_on, '1000-01-01 00:00:00'),
            COALESCE(CONCAT(IFNULL(repeat_till, '1000-01-01'), ' 00:00:00'), '1000-01-01 00:00:00')
        ) < %s
    """
    query_extra = ""
    args_base = [cutoff]
    if row.get("event_category"):
        query_extra = query_extra + " AND event_category = %s"
        args_base.append(row.event_category)
    if row.get("event_type"):
        query_extra = query_extra + " AND event_type = %s"
        args_base.append(row.event_type)
    if row.get("status"):
        query_extra = query_extra + " AND status = %s"
        args_base.append(row.status)
    count = 0
    pack_count = 0
    page_num = 0
    offset = 0
    while True:
        query = query_base + query_extra + " ORDER BY name LIMIT %s OFFSET %s"
        args = tuple(args_base) + (PAGE_LENGTH, offset)
        names = [r[0] for r in frappe.db.sql(query, args)]
        if not names:
            break
        page_num = page_num + 1
        for name in names:
            try:
                frappe.delete_doc("Event", name, force=1, ignore_permissions=True)
                pack_count = pack_count + 1
                count = count + 1
                if pack_count >= MAX_PACK:
                    frappe.db.commit()
                    log("Data Cleanup Event: committed batch of %s" % (MAX_PACK,))
                    pack_count = 0
            except Exception as e:
                frappe.log_error("Data Cleanup Event delete error for %s" % (name,), e, "Event", name)
                log("Data Cleanup: error deleting Event %s (see Error Log)" % (name,))
        log("Data Cleanup Event: page %s, deleted batch %s, total so far %s" % (page_num, len(names), count))
        #offset = offset + PAGE_LENGTH
        if pack_count:
            frappe.db.commit()
            pack_count = 0
    deleted_total = deleted_total + count
    log("Data Cleanup Event rule days=%s deleted=%s" % (row.days, count))
log("Data Cleanup Event: finished total_deleted=%s" % (deleted_total,))

script:
# Code for Server Script (Scheduler Event, Daily).
# Uses only safe_exec API: frappe.*, log, enqueue (safe_enqueue).

JOB_TIMEOUT = 3000

log("Data Cleanup: start")
rules = frappe.get_doc("Data Cleanup Rules")
today = frappe.utils.getdate()
log("Data Cleanup: today=%s" % (today,))
enabled_version = sum(1 for r in (rules.version_rules or []) if r.get("enabled") and r.get("days"))
enabled_comment = sum(1 for r in (rules.comment_rules or []) if r.get("enabled") and r.get("days"))
enabled_file = sum(1 for r in (rules.file_rules or []) if r.get("enabled") and r.get("days"))
enabled_comm = sum(1 for r in (rules.communication_rules or []) if r.get("enabled") and r.get("days"))
enabled_event = sum(1 for r in (rules.event_rules or []) if r.get("enabled") and r.get("days"))
enabled_workflow = sum(1 for r in (rules.workflow_rules or []) if r.get("enabled") and r.get("days"))
log("Data Cleanup: rules enabled Version=%s Comment=%s File=%s Communication=%s Event=%s Workflow=%s" % (enabled_version, enabled_comment, enabled_file, enabled_comm, enabled_event, enabled_workflow))

if enabled_version:
    frappe.enqueue(function="dinext_common_data_cleanup_version", queue="long", timeout=JOB_TIMEOUT, job_name="Dinext Data Cleanup Version")
if enabled_comment:
    frappe.enqueue(function="dinext_common_data_cleanup_comment", queue="long", timeout=JOB_TIMEOUT, job_name="Dinext Data Cleanup Comment")
if enabled_file:
    frappe.enqueue(function="dinext_common_data_cleanup_file", queue="long", timeout=JOB_TIMEOUT, job_name="Dinext Data Cleanup File")
if enabled_comm:
    frappe.enqueue(function="dinext_common_data_cleanup_communication", queue="long", timeout=JOB_TIMEOUT, job_name="Dinext Data Cleanup Communication")
if enabled_event:
